item.title: 🖼 #ساخت_تصویر دونفره با هوش مصنوعی
item.description:
#ساخت_تصویر دونفره با هوش مصنوعی

◀️عکست رو توی Gemini آپلود کن، Image رو فعال کن و پرامپت زیر رو بنویس

Create an ultra-realistic 8K cinematic full-body couple portrait, built strictly from the uploaded reference image(s). Preserve 100% facial identity, face shape, skin texture, hairstyle, hair color, hairline, beard (if any), body proportions, and body weight for both subjects with absolutely no changes. Faces must remain exactly identical to the reference. Scene & pose: A 24-year-old handsome Bangladeshi man sits casually on a sleek black leather sofa in a modern, stylish lounge. He faces the camera directly with a confident yet soft smile. His posture is relaxed: one arm resting along the sofa’s backrest and one leg crossed over the other. Beside him, his girlfriend sits close, leaning slightly toward him with a graceful, natural smile. Their body language feels genuine, elegant, and comfortably intimate. Wardrobe & styling (original, non-branded): Man wears a modern, well-fitted outfit that complements a premium lounge setting (clean, minimalist, logo-free). Woman wears a chic pastel dress with subtle jewelry and minimal makeup; her silky hair flows naturally. No logos, no readable text, no branding. Environment: A luxurious contemporary lounge with glass and metallic décor elements. Ambient neon lighting adds soft, colorful reflections on surrounding surfaces, enhancing depth and atmosphere without overpowering skin tones. Lighting & mood: Cinematic, ultra-realistic lighting with soft neon accents. Balanced highlights and smooth shadow gradients sculpt faces and fabrics naturally. Vibrant yet elegant mood, premium lifestyle aesthetic. Detail & realism: Hyper-detailed textures on skin, hair, fabric, leather, glass, and metal. Accurate reflections, natural depth of field, and crisp focus maintain photorealism. Technical output: Aspect ratio 2:3 (portrait). Ultra-high-resolution 8K photorealism, DSLR-level clarity, natural color balance. Negative prompts: any facial change, face reshaping, identity alteration, hair change, body reshaping, skin smoothing, beauty filters, de-aging, face-swap artifacts, cartoon or CGI style, HDR glow, oversharpening, blur, noise, distortion, incorrect anatomy, artificial color grading, logos, readable text, watermark

◀️عکست رو توی Gemini آپلود کن، Image رو فعال کن و پرامپت زیر رو بنویس

Create a high-resolution, clean infographic-style personal color analysis poster using the provided portrait. The layout should be modern and minimal with a large, sharp main portrait and organized sections showing best colors, avoid colors, neutrals, and outfit combinations. Include side-by-side comparisons of the subject wearing different shirt colors, making sure all small images are clear, realistic, and remain sharp when zoomed, with no face distortion.

All text should be in Persian (Farsi) with short labels only (no paragraphs), using two different readable fonts: a bold font for titles and a simple font for descriptions. Include sections like "آنالیز رنگ شخصی"، "فصل شما: زمستان عمیق"، "بهترین رنگ‌ها"، "رنگ‌های نامناسب"، and "بهترین ترکیب‌ها"، with an elegant light background and a premium, balanced visual style.
